name: ef01b-chip-view
check: cd web && grep -q 'export function effortChip' src/views/conversation.ts && grep -q 'menuitemradio' src/views/conversation.ts && timeout 120 npx tsc --noEmit || { echo 'error: web/src/views/conversation.ts: effortChip missing or tsc fails'; cd web 2>/dev/null; timeout 120 npx tsc --noEmit; exit 1; }

name: ef01b-chip-css
check: cd web && grep -q '^.effort-chip {' src/styles.css && grep -q 'effort-menu button { min-height: 44px' src/styles.css || { echo 'error: web/src/styles.css: effort rules or the 44px phone rule missing'; exit 1; }

name: ef01b-chip-wire
check: cd web && grep -q '"effort-set"' src/main.ts && grep -q 'mount($("#effort-slot"), effortChip(s))' src/main.ts && grep -q 'pcMachineId, effort)' src/main.ts && timeout 120 npx tsc --noEmit || { echo 'error: web/src/main.ts: effort wiring missing or tsc fails'; timeout 120 npx tsc --noEmit; exit 1; }
check_errors:
error: web/src/main.ts: effort wiring missing or tsc fails
src/main.ts(1359,1): error TS1005: '}' expected.

name: ef01b-chip-view2
check: cd web && f=src/views/conversation.ts; for n in 'export function effortChip(s: AppState): SafeHtml' 'role="menuitemradio"' 'data-action="effort-set"' 'data-effort=' 'aria-haspopup="menu"' 'data-action="effort-menu"' 's.effortMenuOpen' 's.draftEffort'; do grep -qF "$n" $f || { echo "error: web/$f: missing $n"; exit 1; }; done; timeout 120 npx tsc --noEmit
check_errors: src/main.ts(118,113): error TS2554: Expected 1 arguments, but got 0.

name: ef01b-chip-wire2
check: cd web && for n in '"effort-set": (el)' '"effort-menu": ()' 'mount($("#effort-slot"), effortChip(s))' 'pcMachineId, effort)' 'let effort: Effort | undefined;' '!t.closest(".effort")' 'if (s.effortMenuOpen) store.set'; do grep -qF "$n" src/main.ts || { echo "error: web/src/main.ts: missing $n"; exit 1; }; done; test $(git diff --numstat src/main.ts | cut -f2) -le 6 || { echo 'error: web/src/main.ts: removed too many lines; only add lines'; exit 1; }; timeout 120 npx tsc --noEmit

name: ef01b-chip-test
check: cd web && test ! -e tests/effort.spec.ts || sh /tmp/claude-1000/-home-khyretos-Docker/b7485bb6-c8eb-4794-9dbc-1de995b25fcc/scratchpad/pw.sh tests/effort.spec.ts
